"In our recent work, we explored this question by training a hardware-efficient #ansatz on the state prepared by the FF-QRAM by Daniel K Park, Francesco Petruccione, Kevin (June-Koo) Rhee."

"We tested using:"
" 🟣 A state vector simulator;"
" 🟣 A noise model simulator."
""

" 🟢 We achieved significant reductions in both circuit #depth and #size with respect to the FF-QRAM, achieving high fidelities."
""
" 🟢 Additionally, by incorporating a #noise model, we observed that the trained hardware-efficient ansatz could effectively counteract noise, boosting the fidelity of our quantum state preparation compared to the original FF-QRAM circuit run with the same noise model."

🔥 My very first #patent has been filed!"
""
"🔙 in 2022, I had an idea about #forking a #quantum state and started writing a scientific paper. But what does "forking" mean?"
""
"Well! It's not that different from forking a #process on classical computers."
""
"🧑🏻‍🔧 In general, we can use this approach to efficiently fork a quantum state into multiple superpositions (processes) and then evolve each superposition independently. Eventually, according to the task, you can also “merge” those results!"
""
"📝 Here is a practical example! You can fork a quantum state encoding a dataset and reuse it for different tasks (i.e., there is no need to recreate the quantum state from scratch for each task)."

"I don't like those who blindly #support Bitcoin."
""
"The value of Bitcoin as #technology should be completely #disentangled from the value of the corresponding #cryptocurrency. "

""
"🌟 Thanks to Blockchain, for the first time, a #digital asset has its own #history."
""
"A digital asset without a history can be copied as many times as you want, so it has no value."
""
"A digital asset with history has its own identity and, therefore, value. "
""
"In my view, this is the core value of Blockchain."
""
"💥 However, what I am most concerned about today, are the blockchain companies."
"In these days of #crypto-panic, I read many posts about employees in the blockchain industry being laid off."
""
"💬 The question is: "Are crypto-panic and layoffs related?""

End of 2015, Netflix lands in Italy."

"I have to be honest, at the time, I didn't know Netflix very well, only from hearsay. However, what I did know, instead, was that Netflix charged a monthly subscription to watch films and TV series."
""
"Before Netflix, to watch something, you just had to do a few google searches and... Taa-Dan! Here's your free pirate film!"
"In this scenario, I wondered how a service, which makes you pay for what you already have for free, could ever catch on."
""
"Today I recognize more than ever how naive that thought was. "
"There is a difference between "shabby" content and "curated" content, and it is precisely that curation that was missing at the time in streaming services and for which users are willing to pay."
""
"This was one of the first moments when I drastically re-evaluated the role of UX/UI in any project. I do believe it is one of the elements (in B2C )that can completely crush your competition.
